name: Ivern - Friend to All
texts: As you play me, choose Bird, Cat, Dog, or Poro. I gain that tag. When I conquer or hold, score 1 point if your units have all of the following tags among them — Bird, Cat, Dog, and Poro.
manual: As you play me, choose Bird, Cat, Dog, or Poro.
When I conquer or hold, score 1 point if your units have all of the following tags among them — Bird, Cat, Dog, and Poro.
